clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, the Stone of Relu is lost to a raptor after an ambush. Archaeologist Flagongut believes it can unlock secrets within ancient fossils.

Explorers' League work uncovered the Stone of Relu. Archaeologist Flagongut believes it can decipher prehistoric fossils gathered from Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. He means to use it on his Wetlands specimens and on the fossil Prospector Remtravel unearthed in Darkshore.

Archaeologist Flagongut was traveling along the Wetlands roads to meet Prospector Whelgar when mottled raptors ambushed him. In the scramble, the relic was lost and swallowed by one of the beasts. The League now seeks the marsh raptors so the ancient stone can be cut from their gullets.
